answer: Most convincing: randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Each epoch, work is scored by a jury drawn by fresh cryptographic randomness from the whole population, unpredictable until just before grading. Like a tide washing over an island, each rotation sweeps away any fixed jury an attacker groomed; the horizon of collusion keeps receding. To pass a fake identity, an attacker must bribe enough of a jury it only learns at the last moment, epoch after epoch, each failure burning staked deposits, so sybil costs beat rewards.
